# HEZQEN

> HEZQEN is a global technology and business intelligence publication by Tinlance. It connects evidence-led reporting, original research and technical analysis across AI & Technology, Cybersecurity, Cloud & Engineering, and Business & Startups.

Tagline: Research. Intelligence. Perspective.

## Publication
- [Homepage](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/): global technology and business intelligence publication.
- [About HEZQEN](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/about): mission, coverage and publisher.
- [Editorial standards](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/editorial-standards): evidence, authorship, human review and corrections principles.
- [Corrections policy](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/corrections): how to report and review factual concerns.
- [Contact](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/contact): editorial and general enquiries.
- [HTML sitemap](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/sitemap): directory of public pages.

## Editorial divisions
- [AI & Technology](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/divisions/ai-technology)
- [Cybersecurity](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/divisions/cybersecurity)
- [Cloud & Engineering](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/divisions/cloud-engineering)
- [Business & Startups](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/divisions/business-startups)

## Labs and infrastructure
- [HEZQEN Labs](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/labs): sixteen planning calculators with visible assumptions and deterministic formulas.
- [VRAM calculator methodology](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/labs/methodology): versioned formulas, model provenance, limitations and public test vectors.
- [RSS feed](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/feed.xml): published article feed.
- [VRAM sizing calculator](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/labs/vram)
- [AI API vs self-hosted cost calculator](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/labs/ai-cost)
- [HEZQEN Infrastructure](https://hezqen.tinlance.com/infrastructure): five engineering-preview kits, not production-certified or commercially released.

## Important status qualifications
- Human editors retain approval and publishing authority.
- AI-generated or retrieved content is not verified evidence.
- Reader accounts, premium subscriptions, production search and automated publishing are not claimed as available.
- Payload CMS integration exists, but shared database migration and operational acceptance remain release gates.
- Infrastructure kits are engineering previews; automated tests do not establish certification or physical hardware validation.
